【原视频简介】
I found this Schnell mountain bike for only $10 and decided to give it a complete makeover. At first glance, the bike looked old, dirty, neglected, and far from its original condition—but I wanted to see how much could be brought back to life with a full restoration.



This project starts with a complete teardown, removing the old components and taking the bicycle down to its individual parts. From there, every part is inspected, cleaned, repaired, restored, or replaced where necessary.


🔧 What happens in this restoration:


Complete bicycle disassembly
Deep cleaning of the frame and components
Removal of dirt, grime, and rust
Restoration and cleaning of old parts
Frame preparation and surface treatment
Fresh primer and new paint
New decals and finishing details
Installation of replacement components
Cleaning and servicing of drivetrain parts
Brake and gear setup
Wheel and tyre installation
Final assembly and adjustments
Complete before-and-after transformation


The goal was not simply to make the bike look better, but to bring this forgotten Schnell MTB back into a clean, functional, and ride-ready condition.


The final result is a huge difference from where this bike started. Watching an old $10 bicycle gradually transform piece by piece is what makes restoration so satisfying.



If you enjoy bicycle restoration, mountain bikes, MTB builds, DIY repairs, deep cleaning, rust removal, painting, mechanical work, satisfying transformations, and before-and-after projects, you're in the right place.



🔔 Subscribe for more complete bicycle restorations and transformations.
